repairApply.recipe: raw SHA-256 of C({operation, projectId, repairPlanId, baseSnapshotId})
repairApply.whyDifferent: content-derived, NOT request-scoped: no requestId and no stepId appear, so the same plan over the same base snapshot has ONE key across separate requests -- the opposite property from the generic recipe

measuredInequalities.note: the three H-based keys differ ONLY in the operation token, which is what the law says; the repair-apply key differs in RECIPE, not just in a field value, and is not an H identity at all

repairApplyPreimageOwner.standing: the kit publishes this key only as a RECIPE string in the mutation operation map; there is no $defs record for the preimage, so it is not schema-admitted as a record. Its three identity members are checked against the typed identities they carry, and the repairPlanId is the admitted positive descriptor of vectors/repair-descriptor.json.
